description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2067/16, adding Bsc Hons (Biotechnology) to the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (Gurantee) Limited
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the amendment of a university degree program under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It is a legal/regulatory action where the Minister exercises powers vested by an Act to modify a schedule in a previous government order. While a Minister is named, the core content is the issuance of a statutory instrument (an Order) that modifies regulations governing academic degrees, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
